title: Set Up Nodics Locally
readerIntent: Prepare and verify a local Nodics development runtime.
priorKnowledge: Basic terminal, Git, Node.js, and database familiarity.
summary: Use the repository runtime versions, install deterministically, build generated artifacts, run baseline tests, and start an explicitly selected local server.

sections.heading: Prerequisites
items: Node.js 24.18.0 is the repository-pinned version; the package accepts Node.js 22 through 26.
The database and optional providers required by the selected local topology.

sections.heading: Start an explicit runtime
paragraphs: Choose the environment and server intentionally. For current BackOffice-oriented local work, the consolidated runtime is the startioLocal monoServer.

If a server name exists in several environments and the terminal is interactive, Nodics prompts for the environment. Automation must supply an unambiguous environment instead of depending on a prompt.

sections.heading: Verify success
items: The process reports the selected environment and server.
Required modules become ready without repeated core-data creation.
No unexpected generated or configuration files appear in Git status.
